prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a new original One Ring culture scene: a rainy village of Men at night, with people going into a welcoming tavern alive with light, music and ale. Wide 16:9 landscape, intended final 2560x1440. A muddy cobbled village lane between modest early medieval timber-and-plaster buildings with steep rain-dark roofs. The main tavern occupies the middle-right of the composition, its broad open wooden doorway and leaded windows spilling strong warm amber light into the wet blue-gray night. Four or five ordinary human villagers and cloaked travelers, distinct loose dark silhouettes, hurry through the rain toward and through the doorway; one shakes rain off a cloak beneath the eave, another steps across the threshold. Keep them mostly backlit and shadow-shrouded, no detailed portraits. Through the open door show a few broad painterly glimpses of companions at a wooden table raising plain ale tankards and a seated musician playing a lute beside a hearth, enough to convey music and conviviality visually. No readable musical notes or sound-effect symbols. A warm lantern by the entrance, timber barrels under the eaves and a small simple tavern sign bearing only an abstract tankard silhouette, no writing. Rain falls in bold slanted paint marks; puddles on the cobbles reflect long broken strokes of amber window light. Distant cottages fade into cold mist. Composition: broad dark framing and near-black human silhouettes in foreground and along the lane, brighter tavern doorway and misty wet environment behind. Strong value separation: people remain darker than the surroundings, faces mostly lost in shadow; the warm inn is the visual destination. Mood: refuge, fellowship, warmth and ale after a cold wet journey; lived-in village of ordinary Men, grounded understated Middle-earth setting, no modern objects. Palette: deep charcoal, muted slate-blue and gray rain, restrained umber timber, vivid but localized amber-gold light. REQUIRED STYLE: very thick broad expressive gouache and oil-like brush strokes, chunky rough palette-knife shapes, dragged broken edges and scumbled pigment textures; large simplified value masses and lost edges. Bold evocative fantasy book painting, not finely detailed realism. No intricate faces, individual hair, tiny costume ornament, meticulously drawn bricks or cobblestones, glossy 3D, photographic lighting or smooth airbrushed gradients. Suggest details with a few decisive paint marks. Full coherent artwork to every edge; no text, labels, letters, captions, watermark, borders, white strips, black bars or UI.
